subject: Venture Slate - request for extra trial allocation and timeline
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <sam.reed@venture-slate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lia Chen <lia@scaleup.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary top-up to trial allocation for current cohort

Hi Marissa,

Quick one from our end — our current Venture Slate cohort launched with your standard startup trial (45k tokens), but the program unexpectedly extended two weeks due to speaker scheduling changes and a delayed partner integration. Usage spiked during the last week (we hit the cap and had a handful of queued requests).

Can Redwood provide a one-time top-up or short extension on the trial allocation so we can finish the cohort without throttles?

What would help us:
- a one-time 30k token add-on OR
- extend the trial window by 21 days and lift the cap for that period

Attaching the cohort agreement and a small usage snapshot. We’re happy to sign a brief addendum or accept a usage-based surcharge — just want to avoid interrupted sessions for the mentors and participants.

Thanks,
Samantha Reed
Head of Partnerships, Venture Slate
sam.reed@venture-slate.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: venture-slate-cohort-agreement.pdf, usage-snapshot-nov.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <sam.reed@venture-slate.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary top-up to trial allocation for current cohort

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for sending the snapshot. Sorry to hear the schedule shifted.

Looping in Connor (CS) to confirm the technical impact and propose an operational fix, and Evelyn on finance to propose an approval path for a temporary top-up.

Connor/Evelyn — can you review the attached usage CSV and the cohort dates (the agreement says cohort runs through 12/07). If we can confirm the spike is short-lived, I’d prefer a one-time credit so they don’t get billed unexpectedly. If we need a longer window, we can do an addendum with a small escalation fee.

Samantha — I’ll get back with a concrete proposal by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: vs-addendum-draft.docx (placeholder)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <sam.reed@venture-slate.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary top-up to trial allocation for current cohort

Thanks for the ping. Quick read of the CSV: the spike is concentrated over three days and primarily from the mentor Q&A sessions (bursty but predictable). Technically we can do two things:

- Apply a one-time 30,000-token credit (instant, no infra changes).
- Or temporarily raise their per-minute concurrency and extend the cap window; that requires a short config change but is doable within 2 business days.

Operationally I recommend the one-time credit + a short extension of 10 days to cover any follow-ups. That minimizes config churn and keeps the cohort experience intact.

If we apply a credit, I’ll also temporarily disable the cap for their cohort id so queued requests don’t fail while the credit is consumed. I’ve attached a usage slice for your reference (same CSV rows filtered).

Connor O'Brien
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Attachment: usage-snapshot-nov.csv

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <sam.reed@venture-slate.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary top-up to trial allocation for current cohort

Hi all — finance OK to approve a one-time 30k token promotional credit for Venture Slate, conditional on a signed addendum that covers the extended end date and a small surcharge if they exceed the top-up. Suggested wording in the addendum: one-time 30,000 token credit; trial extended by 10 calendar days; any usage beyond that is billed at standard trial overage rates.

I’ll prepare a short billing memo and routing for approval. For tracking, please log this under deal VS-2026-118 and add the DocuSign link once Marissa sends the doc.

Evelyn Hart
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com

Attachment: finance-approval-note.txt (internal stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <sam.reed@venture-slate.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary top-up to trial allocation for current cohort

Hi Samantha — good news: we can do a one-time 30,000 token credit and extend your trial window by 10 days. Evelyn has approved the credit conditional on a short addendum (adds the extension and standard overage terms).

I’ve uploaded the addendum to DocuSign here: https://na1.docusign.net/VS_Addendum_2026. Once signed we’ll apply the credit and temporarily lift the cap for the cohort id. Expected timeline:
- You sign addendum: same day
- We apply credit + lift cap: within 4 hours of signed DocuSign
- CS will monitor usage and stand by for any config needs

If you’d prefer we can also do a usage surcharge instead of the credit — let me know. Otherwise please sign the addendum and I’ll confirm when the credit is live.

Thanks everyone — CC’ing our legal channel is not necessary here since this is an addendum to an existing agreement.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
